summary.headline: Hyleg and Life-Length Directions
summary.text: Astrological rules for selecting the Hyleg and determining the periods of life from the part of fortune or, in a conjunctional nativity, the preceding conjunction of the Sun and Moon; it also introduces the preceding prevention or opposition, called the Moon’s impletion.
